description: Tangible resource of the utility, including power system equipment, various end devices, cabinets, buildings, etc. For electrical network equipment, the role of the asset is defined through PowerSystemResource and its subclasses, defined mainly in the Wires model (refer to IEC61970-301 and model package IEC61970::Wires). Asset description places emphasis on the physical characteristics of the equipment fulfilling that role.
title: Asset

Structure.removeWeed.title: removeWeed
Structure.removeWeed.description: True if weeds are to be removed around asset.

EndDevice.isVirtual.title: isVirtual
EndDevice.isVirtual.description: If true, there is no physical device. As an example, a virtual meter can be defined to aggregate the consumption for two or more physical meters. Otherwise, this is a physical hardware device.

Structure.height.title: height
Structure.height.description: Visible height of structure above ground level for overhead construction (e.g., Pole or Tower) or below ground level for an underground vault, manhole, etc. Refer to associated DimensionPropertiesInfo for other types of dimensions.

Pole.breastBlock.title: breastBlock
Pole.breastBlock.description: True if a block of material has been attached to base of pole in ground for stability. This technique is used primarily when anchors can not be used.

ComModule.amrSystem.title: amrSystem
ComModule.amrSystem.description: Automated meter reading (AMR) system communicating with this com module.

DuctBank.circuitCount.title: circuitCount
DuctBank.circuitCount.description: Number of circuits in duct bank. Refer to associations between a duct (ConductorAsset) and an ACLineSegment to understand which circuits are in which ducts.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

ComModule.timeZoneOffset.title: timeZoneOffset
ComModule.timeZoneOffset.description: Time zone offset relative to GMT for the location of this com module.

EndDevice.timeZoneOffset.title: timeZoneOffset
EndDevice.timeZoneOffset.description: Time zone offset relative to GMT for the location of this end device.

IdentifiedObject.description.title: description
IdentifiedObject.description.description: The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

EndDevice.isPan.title: isPan
EndDevice.isPan.description: If true, this is a premises area network (PAN) device.

Structure.materialKind.title: materialKind
Structure.materialKind.description: Material this structure is made of.

Meter.formNumber.title: formNumber
Meter.formNumber.description: Meter form designation per ANSI C12.10 or other applicable standard. An alphanumeric designation denoting the circuit arrangement for which the meter is applicable and its specific terminal arrangement.

EndDevice.amrSystem.title: amrSystem
EndDevice.amrSystem.description: Automated meter reading (AMR) or other communication system responsible for communications to this end device.

Structure.ratedVoltage.title: ratedVoltage
Structure.ratedVoltage.description: Maximum rated voltage of the equipment that can be mounted on/contained within the structure.

Pole.construction.title: construction
Pole.construction.description: The framing structure mounted on the pole.

Pole.treatmentKind.title: treatmentKind
Pole.treatmentKind.description: Kind of treatment for this pole.

Pole.classification.title: classification
Pole.classification.description: Pole class: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, H1, H2, Other, Unknown.

Vehicle.usageKind.title: usageKind
Vehicle.usageKind.description: Kind of usage of the vehicle.

Pole.length.title: length
Pole.length.description: Length of the pole (inclusive of any section of the pole that may be underground post-installation).

IdentifiedObject.aliasName.title: aliasName
IdentifiedObject.aliasName.description:
The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

Joint.fillKind.title: fillKind
Joint.fillKind.description: Material used to fill the joint.

Pole.treatedDateTime.title: treatedDateTime
Pole.treatedDateTime.description: Date and time pole was last treated with preservative.

IdentifiedObject.name.title: name
IdentifiedObject.name.description: The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

Pole.speciesType.title: speciesType
Pole.speciesType.description: Pole species. Aluminum, Aluminum Davit, Concrete, Fiberglass, Galvanized Davit, Galvanized, Steel Davit Primed, Steel Davit, Steel Standard Primed, Steel, Truncated, Wood-Treated, Wood-Hard, Wood-Salt Treated, Wood-Soft, Wood, Other, Unknown.

EndDevice.isSmartInverter.title: isSmartInverter
EndDevice.isSmartInverter.description: If true, there is a communicating inverter present.

Meter.connectionCategory.title: connectionCategory
Meter.connectionCategory.description: A code used to specify the connection category, e.g. low voltage, where the meter operates.

ComModule.supportsAutonomousDst.title: supportsAutonomousDst
ComModule.supportsAutonomousDst.description: If true, autonomous daylight saving time (DST) function is supported.

Tool.lastCalibrationDate.title: lastCalibrationDate
Tool.lastCalibrationDate.description: (if applicable) Date the tool was last calibrated.

Streetlight.armLength.title: armLength
Streetlight.armLength.description: Length of arm. Note that a new light may be placed on an existing arm.

Pole.baseKind.title: baseKind
Pole.baseKind.description: Kind of base for this pole.

Joint.insulation.title: insulation
Joint.insulation.description: The type of insulation around the joint, classified according to the utility's asset management standards and practices.

Pole.preservativeKind.title: preservativeKind
Pole.preservativeKind.description: Kind of preservative for this pole.

Vehicle.odometerReadDateTime.title: odometerReadDateTime
Vehicle.odometerReadDateTime.description: Date and time the last odometer reading was recorded.

Vehicle.odometerReading.title: odometerReading
Vehicle.odometerReading.description: Odometer reading of this vehicle as of the 'odometerReadingDateTime'. Refer to associated ActivityRecords for earlier readings.

IdentifiedObject.mRID.title: mRID
IdentifiedObject.mRID.description:
Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.
